question: At a fixed 250 ms X11 hold deadline, how much application-observed hold extension remains when the pre-release retained-observation pipeline stops after capture + PNG save + fsync and omits PNG reopen/load?
fixture: Xvfb 1024x768x24 + Openbox + rendered Tk checkerboard + XTEST w key
pipeline: full-frame Pillow ImageGrab -> PNG save -> fsync; no reopen/load

conditions.release_first: at deadline send KeyRelease+sync, then execute capture+PNG save+fsync
conditions.pipeline_first: at deadline execute capture+PNG save+fsync, then send KeyRelease+sync

primary_metric: paired pipeline_first-minus-release_first application-observed press-to-release duration in ms

decision.write_boundary_cost_candidate: median paired delta >= 10 ms OR p95 paired delta >= 20 ms
decision.reject_as_tens_ms_explanation: median paired delta < 10 ms AND p95 paired delta < 20 ms

construction_smoke: 2 pairs, excluded; observed median paired delta 16.734758 ms before schema-label-only cleanup
